description: Agent capability demonstration scenarios — shows agent types across 9 categories with graph-based analysis.

scenarios.title: Trace and Impact Analysis
scenarios.question: Trace EOIP-1 to its implementation and assess the blast radius of changing compute_impact()
scenarios.expected_output: Path from WorkItem through Commit to CodeSymbol, plus dependent entities

scenarios.title: Incident Root Cause Analysis
scenarios.question: What caused INC0071042 and which deployment introduced the regression?
scenarios.expected_output: Incident → Alert → Deployment → Pipeline → Commit → MergeRequest chain

scenarios.title: HIPAA Compliance Verification
scenarios.question: Verify that all patient data handling meets HIPAA technical safeguards
scenarios.expected_output: Compliance check against PHI encryption, access logging, audit trail

scenarios.title: Release Governance Check
scenarios.question: Is release 2026.10.1 ready? Check tests, deployment, monitoring, and documentation
scenarios.expected_output: Multi-step workflow checking test runs, pipeline status, monitoring, docs

scenarios.title: Graph Anomaly Detection
scenarios.question: Find orphan vertices, disconnected components, and suspicious patterns in the graph
scenarios.expected_output: List of anomalies: orphan vertices, missing edges, unusual patterns

scenarios.title: Design to Delivery Trace
scenarios.question: Trace the checkout payment panel design from Figma to the deployed code
scenarios.expected_output: DesignComponent → Feature → WorkItem → MR → Code → Pipeline → Deployment

scenarios.title: Knowledge Provenance Verification
scenarios.question: Where did the answer about checkout timeout behavior come from and how trustworthy is it?
scenarios.expected_output: Evidence chain: KB article → source system → evidence record with confidence

scenarios.title: API Blast Radius Assessment
scenarios.question: What is the blast radius if the Checkout API goes down?
scenarios.expected_output: Upstream/downstream services, dependent tests, monitoring coverage

scenarios.title: Multi-perspective Code Review
scenarios.question: Review the risk decision implementation from security, performance, and reliability perspectives
scenarios.expected_output: Three independent assessments merged into a consensus review
